svg.title: Cells stamped against correct answers: with replacement versus a 45-fact deal
svg.desc: Line chart. X axis: correct answers in a run, 0 to 50. Y axis: distinct facts stamped, 0 to 45. A gold curve shows the shipped with-replacement draw, 45 times (1 minus (44/45) to the k), flattening to 30.4 at 50 answers. A dashed reference line shows a deal without replacement, where every correct answer stamps a new cell, reaching the full card at 45. Markers: Endless 9.8 answers, 8.7 cells; Classic without faces 18.6 answers, 15.5 cells; thirty answers all correct, 22.1 cells; Card, all runs 23.3; Card, completed runs 31.7. Filling the card with replacement takes about 198 correct answers.
